\begin{lemma}[Quantifier bits in a paired encoding]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.getD_quant}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.getD_quant}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.getD_enc, Std.Sat.CNF.serialize, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{3}
Let $x$ and $q$ be finite bit strings, and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over
natural-number variables. If $x$ is the pairing of $q$ with the binary encoding of
$\varphi$, then for every index $k<|q|$, the bits of $x$ at positions $2k$ and $2k+1$
both equal the $k$th bit of $q$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Inductive specification for quantified formulas]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.inner_spec}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.inner_spec}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.AReach.refl, Complexity.LogProg.AReach.trans, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.A, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.CallOK, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.Run, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.Val, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.cont, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.fin_of, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.getD_quant, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.length_enc, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.node_run, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.pop_run, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.push_run, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.qlook_run, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.read_b, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.read_f, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.read_t, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.step_of, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.stp, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.stp_bd, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.val_all, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.val_ex, Complexity.LogProg.astep, Std.Sat.CNF.serialize, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{6}
Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables, let $qs$ be a Boolean quantifier prefix, and let $x$ encode $qs$ paired with the serialization of $\varphi$. Suppose $2^{|qs|+1}\le B$ and $|x|\le B$. For every $k<|qs|$, correctness of the bounded program at depth $k+1$ implies correctness at depth $k$: if, for every $S<2^{k+2}$, its run from the node configuration $(k+1,S,0)$ reaches the return label with value $\operatorname{decide}(\mathrm{Val}(qs,\varphi,k+1,S))$ and the same register state, then for every $S<2^{k+1}$ the run from $(k,S,0)$ reaches the return label with value $\operatorname{decide}(\mathrm{Val}(qs,\varphi,k,S))$ and the same register state.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Bounded quantified formula calls]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.call_spec}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.call_spec}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.CallOK, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.inner_spec, Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.leaf_spec, Std.Sat.CNF.serialize, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{4}
Let $x$ and $qs$ be Boolean words, let $B$ be a natural number, and let $\varphi$ be a
CNF formula over natural-number variables. Suppose $x$ is the pair encoding of $qs$ and
the serialization of $\varphi$, that $2^{|qs|+1}\le B$, and that $|x|\le B$. For every
pair of natural numbers $j,k$ with $k+j=|qs|$, and every $S<2^{k+1}$, the machine
reaches, from the node state with depth $k$, assignment stack $S$, and input pointer
$0$, the return state carrying the truth value of evaluating $\varphi$ under the
remaining quantifiers of $qs$ and the assignment encoded by $(k,S)$; the ending depth,
stack, and input pointer are unchanged.
\end{theorem}
